digest.component_or_area: LLM eval harness for code-review-concurrency overlay
propositions: An eval spec for the concurrency overlay must be authored to guard prompt edits against regression in recall/precision behavior on a traced corpus of real race conditions.
The spec must define minimal diff hunks distilled from traced commits (R1: unlocked twin via subprocess.run, R2: check-then-act TOCTOU, F1–F3: no-fire controls), each with provenance comments.

Gating behavior: an epoch passes iff all applicable gating scorers pass all their cases; gate passes iff at_least(2) of 3 epochs pass; coverage_threshold is a run-success floor not a pass lever; a persistently-failing gating recall case fails the gate regardless.
R3 (fail-open guard) must be included as a non-gating documented stretch (commented hunk block) rather than a scored case, so it cannot fail the gate by construction.

The spec must pass validation: rebar prompt eval code-review-concurrency exits 0; at least 2 scored recall cases and at least 3 scored no-fire cases exist with provenance; F3 deliberate probe-then-skip is a scored expect: pass case.
